plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Dans la Console, copiez la ligne « Refus: In the Console, copy the line that says “Refused to connect” and contains the address https://api.home-connect.com/security/oauth/redirect_target?code=… You can paste the entire line: Jeedom will extract the address and complete the redirection on its own.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Effectuez de préférence cette opération: It is best to perform this step using a web browser on a computer. On a mobile device, the Home Connect app may intercept this address.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Jeedom a déjà préparé la session Home Co: Jeedom has already set up the Home Connect session. SingleKey prevents it from being displayed within Jeedom; therefore, only its login page opens in a new tab.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.La connexion est effectuée directement d: The connection is established directly in your browser. Jeedom never receives or stores your SingleKey password.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.N’attendez pas la redirection automatiqu: Don't wait for the automatic redirect that's scheduled to occur after 3 seconds: open the Console and click CONTINUE yourself.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Ouvrez les outils de développement avec: Open the developer tools by pressing F12 before clicking CONTINUE.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Pour votre sécurité, cette autorisation: For your security, this authorization expires after 15 minutes and can only be used once.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Repérez « Refused to connect to https:\/: Locate “Refused to connect to https://api.home-connect.com/security/oauth/redirect_target…” and copy this URL or the entire line.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Si votre navigateur affiche directement: If your browser directly displays an address such as hcauth://auth/prod?code=…, that address is also accepted. Do not paste the address singlekey-id.com/redirection or the link singlekey-id.com/auth/connect/authorize/callback.
plugins\/localhomeconnect\/desktop\/moda.Sélectionnez l’onglet Console. L’adresse: Select the Console tab. The address does not appear in Network or Sources.
